_comment: Lives at .7k/layout.json. Where things are drawn, per view, with `*` for the whole model through no lens. See ../docs/spec/20-ir.md section 6.2. Deleting this file loses saved positions and nothing else: every missing node falls back to auto-layout, one node at a time, so adding a service never reshuffles the rest. This copy is an illustration of the format, kept here because a real .7k/layout.json is per-developer and gitignored - unlike views.json, which is shared and so lives at .7k/views.json for real.
